content.title: About
content.content: Yogurt, nonfat milk and fruit is a combination of a low‑fat dairy product, live probiotic cultures, and fresh fruit, often enjoyed as a healthy breakfast or snack. Nonfat milk provides protein and calcium without extra fat, yogurt adds probiotics, and fruit contributes vitamins, minerals and natural sweetness.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The yogurt‑fruit combo is popular worldwide, from Greek yogurt with honey to Scandinavian fruit bowls.
Nonfat milk retains almost all the nutrients of whole milk while containing virtually no fat.
Probiotics in yogurt can support a healthy gut microbiome and improve digestion.
Seasonal fresh fruits are often used, enhancing flavor and vitamin content.
Yogurt with fruit is frequently fortified with vitamin D and calcium for bone health.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: Nonfat milk and yogurt together provide a high‑quality protein source essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Probiotic content
items.content: Live cultures in yogurt promote gut health, aiding digestion and immune function.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: Fruit adds vitamin C, potassium and antioxidants, while milk supplies calcium and vitamin D.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Using nonfat milk makes the product suitable for low‑fat diets without sacrificing nutrition.

items.title: Satiety support
items.content: The blend of protein, probiotics and fruit fiber helps keep you feeling full longer.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: People with lactose intolerance may experience discomfort, although some yogurts contain reduced lactose.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Allergy to casein or whey requires complete avoidance of the product.

items.title: Added sugar
items.content: Pre‑made mixes can contain added sugars; choose unsweetened or low‑sugar versions.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Yogurt’s acidity may cause mild stomach upset in individuals with sensitive digestion.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the yogurt, nonfat milk and fruit as a standalone snack, stir it into granola, blend into smoothies, or use as a topping for pancakes. Mix yogurt with sliced berries, banana or kiwi, and optionally drizzle a little honey for extra sweetness.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the product in the refrigerator at 1‑4 °C. Once opened, consume within 3‑5 days. Do not leave at room temperature for more than 2 hours to prevent bacterial growth.
